strengths: Very high own-site visibility: 95.0% appearance with average rank 2.89.
Strong differentiated product story: peer-to-peer exchange, no house edge, and sub-200ms execution.
Live sports inventory is broad and concrete, which supports relevance for both bettors and traders.
Competitive association is already strong: Pred outperforms Polymarket in appearance rate and rank.
opportunities: Own the category phrase around sports prediction exchange more aggressively so AI engines associate Pred with the concept.
Build more comparison content against Polymarket and Kalshi, since these are the most recognizable alternatives in AI outputs.
Create clearer use-case pages for bettors vs traders to match the two observed customer types.
Leverage live-market performance and order book mechanics to separate Pred from sportsbook-style competitors.
gaps: Polymarket still dominates broader AI association at 87.5%, meaning Pred is visible but not the default reference point.
Kalshi appears in 37.5% of responses with a strong avg rank of 5.27, indicating competition in the prediction-market mindshare layer.
AI responses use generic betting/market language more than Pred’s exchange/trading vocabulary.
There is limited evidence that AI engines understand Pred’s technical edge beyond surface-level descriptors.
